findings.title: Preserve or migrate the removed findMany API
findings.body: The exported InsightsBookingService no longer exposes findMany; it now only returns SQL fragments through getBaseConditions. Existing callers of findMany will fail type checking (or throw at runtime), and callers using the previous WhereInput-returning condition methods cannot pass the new Sql objects to Prisma model queries. This PR updates only the integration test, not production consumers. Migrate all consumers to parameterized $queryRaw queries in the same change, or retain a compatible querying API until that migration is complete.
